jobs.occupation: R&D Engineer - Composite Winding Process (all genders) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: html R&D Engineer – Composite Winding Process (all genders)Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employeeBlackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.R&D Engineer – Composite Winding Process (all genders)Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIESThe What: COPV failure in spaceflight is a solved problem – if the underlying process is right. The quality of our composite winding process determines the quality of every tank we build. We need an engineer who will own this research, drive it forward independently, and help us produce tanks that do not fail.The Why: You are the owner of our composite winding process research. You don’t inherit a finished method – you develop one. From experiment design to test execution, data analysis to team knowledge transfer: you plan the work, run it, and take responsibility for the results.You ensure:- Experiments are designed thoroughly and executed to plan.- Findings are analyzed critically and translated into concrete process improvements.- Knowledge is documented andsharedso the team moves forward together.YOUR MISSIONResearch and improve the composite winding process: Design and run experiments to advance our winding process and improve tank performance. Learn from every project, increase your efficiency over time, and develop improvement ideas.High Performance – Deliver strong results under pressure. Each project makes the next one better.Own your projects end-to-end: Take full responsibility for assigned projects – scope, schedule, and deliverables. Drive projects forward without being prompted. Question your own results and push for better.Accountability – Own your work. Follow through. Deliver results independently.Work closely within the team and across functions: Collaborate effectively within the team and with colleagues across the company. Coordinate on test scheduling, share progress proactively, and contribute to a team that moves as one.Togetherness – The team succeeds together. Support others as you expect to be supported.Share findings and challenge ideas openly: Defend your conclusions with confidence and stay open when others push back. Document and share knowledge proactively – what you learn should not stay with you alone. In our environment, speaking up and being transparent isn't just a value – it's a safety requirement.Candor – Surface problems early. Speak up. Fix things faster.Bring curiosity and ideas to every project: Approach technical challenges with genuine interest and a drive to understand how things work. Bring new ideas to the table, experiment with approaches, and stay energized by the complexity of the problem.Playfulness – Serious about the mission. Driven by curiosity.YOUR PROFILE- Engineering degree in mechanical, aerospace, materials, chemical, or related field (BSc minimum; MSc or PhD preferred).- At least 2 years of hands-on experience with composite materials and their processing.- At least one thesis or job focused on composites– composite materials, processes, dimensioning, testing- Comfortable working in a lab, workshop, or test environment; practical ability comes along with theoretical background.- Willingness to document work thoroughly and share knowledge with the team.- English proficiency, German nice to havePlease upload work references and university transcripts with your application to be considered!WHAT WE OFFER- High level of autonomy and real impact on our technology.- Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and room for your ideas.- Your choice of benefit: Germany ticket,EgymWellpass, or a tax-free Give Card.- Fresh shared lunches and a healthy team culture.- Stunning views of the Alps from our Taufkirchen rooftop terrace.- Growth opportunities: exciting projects and inspiring colleagues.- A team that celebrates success together – tech talks, team events, and after-work gatherings.Please send your CV in English and get ready for take-off!Please refer to reference number YF-51681 for your application.Apply for this job

jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer NeuroscienceFull- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieWe are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.Your responsibilities:The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.Depending on expertise, projects may include:- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly desirable is extensive experience with:- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. - Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram We look forward to meeting you!Contact: Sarah
